sourcePolicy: Original generated PNG bytes archived unchanged. Runtime WebP delivery uses FFmpeg libwebp quality 95, compression level 6. Color encoding is lossy; all dimensions and alpha values are preserved exactly.
camera: Elevated orthographic cutaway, approximately 35 degrees; principal wall faces horizontal and frontal, upper-left light.
cropMethod: Eight main connected alpha>8 bodies per sheet, with four source pixels of padding. All alpha>32 pixels fall within the measured source crops. No neighboring main subjects enter a crop. No source pixel edits or alpha cleanup.
registration: Bottom center of each measured crop. Runtime fitting preserves aspect ratio and remains within the existing 88-pixel back-wall face.
selectionPolicy: Cached wall-only placements subtract existing furniture-18 windows, real doorway spans, hearth and specialist fixture overlap. Single-cell cutaway steps, side walls, south lips and partitions remain unchanged. All chapel walls retain their specialist drawing. At most sixteen details per room; absent or malformed optional images retain existing walls.

sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent interior-wall sprite atlas for the original painterly RPG Ash & Aether. Create ONE landscape 2:1 canvas, EXACTLY FOUR columns by TWO rows, exactly EIGHT independent, fully separated wall details. This is a coherent modest HOME room kit: warm patched limewash, dark repaired timber, muted ochre, a little faded indigo. Hand-painted weathered gouache and watercolor texture, refined but quiet, rounded worn edges. Match an elevated cutaway orthographic RPG camera looking down approximately 35 degrees; all main wall faces face the viewer squarely, long edges horizontal, tiny top ledges visible, upper-left light. These attach to existing 88-pixel-high back wall spans. Each subject is only a shallow wall surface detail, not a room or floor prop. Generous TRUE TRANSPARENT gutters of at least 10% of every cell, no connected shadows, nothing touching cell borders. Keep each entire piece and its soft edge within its cell; equal row heights.

Ordered left-to-right top row:
1. A broad low panel of patched cream limewash above a worn chestnut skirting strip, irregular plaster repairs and two tiny brass mending staples; width about twice height.
2. A broad limewash bay with one restrained diagonal timber brace and visible old pegged join, horizontal top edge; no opening.
3. A short LEFT inside-wall corner return: a pale plaster strip meeting a narrow dark wooden corner post, with a shallow short return plane, no floor; vertical compact piece.
4. A matching RIGHT inside-wall corner return, independently lit from upper left, pale plaster and wooden post, no floor.

Bottom row:
5. A small shallow RECTANGULAR closed-back linen wall recess with a single folded indigo cloth on its inset sill; solid pale back, unmistakably a small wall niche, no doorway or dark passage.
6. A broad small kitchen wall tile inset, faded cream and sage glazed ceramic squares with subtle hand-painted leaf strokes, framed by worn lime plaster; no text.
7. A broad softly weathered plaster repair with faint old smoke staining at the upper edge and a short repaired wood dado; no hearth, fire or fireplace.
8. A long low carved wooden cornice repair strip with tiny pegged joints and a narrow pale plaster backing, width about three times its height; not a door lintel, no doorway frame.

The eight pieces form a consistent lived-in room family. No windows, doors, arches, floor patches, furniture, pots, crates, people, signage, symbols, labels, letters, numbers, watermarks, grids, cell frames or painted background. True alpha transparency outside the eight complete subjects. Keep texture restrained so the details stay legible at a final wall height of roughly 70 pixels. Do not create an isometric diamond base or rotate the main wall plane.

verification.scope: Original/delivery hashes and crop bounds; aspect-preserving anchor and canvas state; immutable room/journey data with window/door reservations; matching Standard/Compatibility positions and unchanged bake bounds; absent/malformed images, off-view culling and decoder failure.
